points: ❌ The atom is 'totally empty'. ✅ It is mostly empty *space*, but ≈99.9% of the mass lies in the nucleus.
❌ α-particles are electrons. ✅ They are helium nuclei (+2e, ≈7300 times heavier than an electron), so…
